data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 labels the relation a 'contradiction' but its own description shows the two targets occupy different causal positions: SRC_005 treats efficiency as a precondition (cause) of discovery, while SRC_004 treats efficiency as an artifact (effect) of suppression. Two claims where one identifies efficiency as a cause and the other as an effect are not logically contradictory — they can both hold simultaneously in a feedback loop where suppression produces efficiency and efficiency enables discovery. The relation kind is misclassified: this is at most a tension or a shared-mechanism divergence, not a contradiction.
